description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Charcoal Canister.
Lowers Emissions.
Reduces “Raw Gas” Smell Emanating from Engine Compartment.
Note: Look at this part carefully as it may require modification to install.
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Charcoal Canister
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki SJ413 All Models with EFI
Suzuki/Maruti Gypsy All Models with EFI
Holden Drover All Models with EFI
Suzuki Caribbean All Models with EFI
